# Jody Story Bail Bonds
> 24/7 Licensed Missouri Bail Bond Agency providing immediate jail release, 10% standard statutory fees, 0% interest financing, and complete county detention center coverage across Eastern and Southeastern Missouri.

## Contact & Dispatch
- **Phone (24/7 Hotline):** (573) 854-9264
- **International:** +1-573-854-9264
- **Main Office:** 100 N Breton St, Potosi, MO 63664
- **Website:** https://jstorybailbonds.com/
- **Hours:** Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year
- **Pricing:** Standard 10% Missouri statutory bail premium with low down payments and flexible financing

## Core Capabilities & Bond Types Handled
- **Felony Bail Bonds:** Aggravated charges, property crimes, serious offenses
- **Misdemeanor Bail Bonds:** Minor offenses, municipal violations
- **DUI / DWI Bail Bonds:** Driving under the influence, BAC violations
- **Failure to Appear (FTA) & Bench Warrants:** Fast warrant clearance and quash assistance
- **Domestic & Probation Violations:** Fast processing through local circuit courts
- **0% Interest Financing:** Flexible payment plans customized for families
